lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in a semi-regular grid posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, with the most intense local maxima forming a central horizontal row of approximately five prominent spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting with horizontal rows of spots, particularly prominent in the mid-flank region where vertical striations align with spot centers.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible running along the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller (low-radius) luminance blobs along its leading edge, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs toward the trailing edge and base.
